integrity: Two independently stated arguments (orbit-by-orbit combinatorial proof and deterministic enumeration); no claim of independent external validation.
scientific_limitations: Only the cyclic order-seven translation-fixed locus of the seven-point complex and its affine normalizer action; no statement about other fixed loci or the ambient equivariant homotopy type.
title: Two Fano fixed points and a quadratic normalizer character in the seven-point intersecting-triples complex
